text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt satisfying, but a gain versus my purchase price is not a reason by itself to sell; I should weigh each stock’s prospects and portfolio role.","I should not hold a losing position merely to avoid admitting a mistake. My purchase price is sunk, and future decisions should reflect current risks and expected returns.","Because prices are unpredictable and I trade infrequently, I should avoid treating recent moves as signals and keep diversification and my overall plan in view."]}
